description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Notifying that the Resolution (The Revenue Protection Order No. 01/2016) made under Sec. 10 of the Customs Ordinance was passed by the Parliament on 10.03.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a resolution passed by Parliament under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) regarding the levying of import duties on specific articles. It establishes new regulatory measures for customs duties, which falls under legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks.
